latin: Cum dixit Abucaten Omnem causam primariam plus influere, per plus intelligas eminentiam modi causandi et intimitatem eius quod in re producitur.
translation: When Abucaten said that every primary cause has a greater influence, by 'greater' you should understand the eminence of the mode of causing and the intimacy of that which is produced in the thing.
